definition.simple: How much two markets tend to move together.
definition.balanced: Correlation runs from −1 (opposite moves) to +1 (moving together). It changes over time. Two trades on pairs that move together can act like one bigger trade, so your total risk is higher than each trade alone suggests.

example: A learner buys two pairs that both have USD as the quote currency. If USD strengthens, both trades may lose at once.
